sources.name: Remote OK
sources.posting_pattern: root-hosted listing pages; verify detail URL before fetch
sources.notes: Root is the job-listing surface; exposes a Remote Jobs API and JSON feed.

sources.name: Himalayas
sources.posting_pattern: /companies/<company>/jobs/<slug>
sources.notes: Use the installed himalayas-search CLI first: its documented API sends q and country eligibility filters before results are returned and exposes expiry/location restrictions. WebSearch is fallback only.

sources.name: Jobicy
sources.posting_pattern: verify from API or a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Advertises Jobs API, MCP, and RSS plus USA, Europe, EMEA, DevOps, analytics, and marketing facets.

sources.name: Remote Jobs by Remote
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Aggregated marketplace at /jobs; do not confuse with Remote's own careers page at /openings. Shows eligibility such as Europe only, United States only, and Anywhere.

sources.name: Remote.io
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public listings expose location and salary; verify listing freshness and employer canonical URLs.

sources.name: Working Nomads
sources.posting_pattern: verify from API or a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public categories and region/country facets; advertises an API. Its guessed /remote-jobs path returned 404, so retain root scope.

sources.name: NoDesk
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Narrow listings path avoids articles and company-directory noise; includes location and category pages.

sources.name: Dynamite Jobs
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public remote-first listings; especially useful for paid ads/PPC, SEO, marketing, operations, and technical roles.

sources.name: Remote100K
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public $100K+ listings with country, region, role, contract, and full-time facets.

sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Important public board; direct automated fetch returned 403, so use WebSearch fallback or assess a compliant CLI separately.

sources.name: Remote.co
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Direct audit timed out; retain root scope and secondary tier until a dedicated listings path is health-verified.

sources.name: EU Remote Jobs
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: High Estonia relevance; direct audit returned 403, not a dead-source verdict.

sources.name: Remote Rocketship
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Direct audit returned 403; verify unique yield before promotion.

sources.name: Jobspresso
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public manually curated technology, AI/data, marketing, and support listings.

sources.name: DailyRemote
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Use strict remote-work-mode and eligibility verification; exposes country facets including Estonia, Europe, US, and Worldwide.

sources.name: JustRemote
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public listings and applicant-country list include Estonia; Power Search is separately paid.

sources.name: Wellfound
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Strong startup/AI source; job seekers can apply free, but profile and platform mechanics affect coverage. Narrow the root scope only after a listings path is health-verified.

sources.name: Y Combinator Startup Jobs
sources.posting_pattern: /companies/<company>/jobs/<slug> or verify live result
sources.notes: High-quality startup, AI, cloud, and remote coverage; apply and filters may benefit from a candidate profile.

sources.name: Built In Remote
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Strong US remote technology source with salary, skills, and company metadata; not a primary Estonia source.

sources.name: Jobgether
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Direct audit returned 403; confirm work mode and candidate eligibility per posting.

sources.name: SkipTheDrive
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Free public search; contains remote and hybrid roles, so strict verification is required.

sources.name: Rat Race Rebellion
sources.posting_pattern: editorial summaries link to employer postings
sources.notes: Use as human-curated discovery only; final verification and application must use the original employer posting.

sources.name: Virtual Vocations
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public browse surface, but premium membership gates the full human-vetted database.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.posting_pattern: verify from API, RSS, or a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Public page reports only 0.4% of available roles visible; investigate official API/RSS limits before automating.

sources.name: FlexJobs
sources.posting_pattern: verify manually
sources.notes: Hand-vetted paid source; do not claim automated completeness.

sources.name: Arc
sources.posting_pattern: platform matching; verify manually
sources.notes: Vetted freelance/full-time talent marketplace, not equivalent to a conventional open job board.

sources.name: Contra
sources.posting_pattern: platform projects and hiring workspace; verify manually
sources.notes: Useful for independent work, not automated permanent-job search.

sources.name: Toptal
sources.posting_pattern: vetted-network matching
sources.notes: Vetted talent network; direct audit returned 403.

sources.name: Upwork
sources.posting_pattern: platform project search
sources.notes: Freelance marketplace; do not use generic site queries for automated permanent-job searches.

sources.name: Robert Half
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Run only through the us-staffing preset; retain root scope until a listings path is health-verified.

sources.name: Creative Circle
sources.posting_pattern: candidate-hub/platform search; verify from live result
sources.notes: Creative/marketing staffing; run only through the us-staffing preset.

sources.name: Onward Search
sources.posting_pattern: verify from a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Marketing, creative, technology, gaming, and AI staffing; run only through the us-staffing preset. Retain root scope until a listings path is health-verified.

sources.name: Job Board Search
sources.posting_pattern: directory entries, not employer postings
sources.notes: Use to discover additional boards, not in ordinary posting searches.

sources.name: Pangian
sources.notes: Site says it is in transition and does not expose a usable job board.

sources.name: Hubstaff Talent
sources.notes: Hubstaff root is currently the time-tracking product; re-add only after the current Talent job-board surface is verified.

sources.name: Outsourcely
sources.posting_pattern: verify manually before automation
sources.notes: Direct audit failed; retain as manual-only until public search and detail access are verified.

sources.name: TryRemotely
sources.posting_pattern: verify from API, RSS, or a live result before detail fetch
sources.notes: Now markets remote and hybrid inventory and visibly includes on-site roles; not eligible for remote-only automated results without a robust work-mode filter.
